messages:
maya: Heads up — vendor call this morning flagged a microcode holdup for Gaudi revB that pushes availability by ~3 weeks. Need to decide marketplace press slot and SI onboarding cadence. @tom_k @santiago

Tom_K: Oof. Do we have affected purchase orders? @jason_hpe?

jason_hpe: yes, our build shows 2 production lots delayed. We can provide a backfill pool of B200 units for customers who need immediate capacity, but perf profile differs. Will share SKU mappings.

maya: Can we formalize fallback policy? Suggest: 1) auto-route low-latency requests to H200 pool, 2) enable backfill pool for batch training, 3) note perf delta in release notes.

priya: Also need SI runbook updates: test matrix for quantized models on fallback hardware, and a compatibility badge for marketplace UI.

santiago: I can own test matrix. ETA Tue EOD for initial pass.

Tom_K: For embargo/announce — push press window by 2 weeks? Marketing prefers not to, they want to keep momentum. Could we do a staged announcement: marketplace beta remains, GA with full SKU when inventory ready.

maya: Staged announce seems good. @announce-bot can we tentatively reserve press slots — placeholder dates: 2026-05-10 (beta), 2026-05-24 (GA)?

announce-bot: :white_check_mark: Press slots tentatively held. Reminder: coordinate with PR 48h prior.

maya: Ops action items: @santiago update compatibility matrix, @priya coordinate SI docs, @tom_k confirm routing policy config, @jason_hpe share expected shipment dates + alt SKUs. I'll draft the marketplace copy.

Tom_K: Routing config snippet for runtime team:
```
route_policy {
  preferred: gaudi-revB
  fallback: h200-pool, b200-backfill
  latency_sla_ms: 120
}
```

priya: SI doc outline: test cases, perf benches, customer migration checklist, known perf deltas.

jason_hpe: I'll upload the SKU mapping spreadsheet and revised ETA by EOD PST.

santiago: Found one test failure on quantization path on H200 for model X — will add to issues.

maya: Thanks. Quick ask — flag any customers we should proactively contact (high ARR) so CS can prepare messaging.

Tom_K: List: AcmeCorp, NimbusAI, ShopFlow — I'll ping CS.

maya: Great. Next sync Thu 09:30 PT. Closing notes: keep embargo on external comms until we confirm shipment schedule. :lock:
